behaviours.label: Click + Add → Pulls next suggestion into the chip list
Click a chip → Removes the chip
Click a swatch → Toggles aria-pressed on the swatch
Type into Min/Max/Search → Controlled values update; appliedAt is cleared
Click Reset → Restores seed tags, clears swatch, restores range defaults
Click Apply → Stamps appliedAt timestamp; status label switches to 'Applied · {time}'
